sections.content: találkozik ('to meet') ends in -ik, so its first-person singular is találkozom, not 'találkozok' -- though the plural we-form, találkozunk, looks perfectly regular. hétvégén uses the locative -n on hétvége ('weekend'), giving 'on/at the weekend'.

items.english: Are we meeting at the weekend?

sections.content: Remember the -ik pattern from utazik and érkezik: any verb ending in -ik in its dictionary form takes -om/-em/-öm for 'I', so it's 'találkozom', never 'találkozok'.
